(b) New demo.client seeded fresh in Mongo with role=client, name='Carlos Demo', email_verified=true (verified directly against users collection — the /api/auth/login response intentionally omits the email_verified field so we asserted at the DB layer). (c) /manifest.json 200 with background_color='#FFFFFF' (was #F7F6F2). (d) All 14 /splash/splash-*.png assets return 200 + image/png. Frontend Playwright: DownloadBadgesSection renders BEFORE <footer> on /, all 5 testids present (download-badges-section, download-section-title, download-section-install, download-section-learn-more, download-qr-block, download-platform-hints) — H1 computed color = rgb(255,255,255) on the teal gradient (transparent-text bug confirmed fixed). QR SVG renders inside download-qr-block. Two platform hint chips ('iPhone — Safari', 'Android — Chrome / Edge') present. Clicking download-section-install opens [data-testid=install-app-modal] with the same QR. Footer social row: 4 elements with data-testid^=footer-social- (1 row container + Instagram/Facebook/TikTok). All 3 anchors have target=_blank rel='noopener noreferrer' and the placeholder URLs. .glass-header computed backdrop-filter='saturate(1.8) blur(20px)', background='rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78)' — content visible through it after scroll. index.html serves exactly 14 <link rel='apple-touch-startup-image'> tags and <meta apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style content='default'>. Client login E2E: filled demo.client@getamano.com/client123 → landed on /dashboard/client with toast 'Welcome to getamano' and 'Hola, Carlos Demo' — did NOT redirect to /verificar-correo. Regression: /plans h1='Plans for providers' renders; /buscar?q=limpesa returns 1 card (result-card-maria-cleaning-services-sallisaw-ok); admin login + /admin and /dashboard/admin both reachable; BottomNav correctly absent on /admin.
critical_code_review_comments: DownloadBadgesSection.jsx h2 fix is correct — applies both Tailwind `text-white` and inline style={color:'#FFFFFF'} so any global CSS that previously set color:transparent on .text-gradient or similar won't bleed through. Same defensive pattern as the iter-25 category hub fix.

Footer social row uses target='_blank' with rel='noopener noreferrer' — security best practice respected. Placeholder URLs (instagram.com/getamano, facebook.com/getamano, tiktok.com/@getamano) currently 404 in the real world; harmless for staging but flag for launch checklist.

manifest.json background_color #FFFFFF + apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style=default + 14 apple-touch-startup-image links + white-bg splash PNGs gives a clean native-app boot experience on iOS (no more dark flash). Consider also setting <meta name='theme-color' content='#FFFFFF' media='(prefers-color-scheme: light)'> to match.

Demo client seed (server.py ~line 819) is idempotent (skips if email already exists) and sets email_verified=true so OTP gate is bypassed. Verified in Mongo: doc present, role=client, name='Carlos Demo', email_verified=True. Good.

Login API response (POST /api/auth/login) does NOT expose `email_verified` in the user payload. Not a bug per se (FE relies on a separate /api/auth/me or the redirect logic on the server side), but worth documenting because the review_request's bullet ‘should NOT redirect to /verificar-correo’ has to be validated via the redirect itself (which we did — lands on /dashboard/client). If FE ever needs to gate UI on this field it'll have to call a second endpoint.
QRCodeSVG uses window.location.origin at render time — correctly produces a QR that matches whichever environment serves the page (staging vs prod). No hardcoded URL.

.glass-header now uses backdrop-filter: saturate(1.8) blur(20px) + rgba(255,255,255,0.78). On Safari this requires -webkit-backdrop-filter for older versions; modern Safari (16+) supports unprefixed. If you still want iOS 14/15 coverage, add the -webkit- prefix.

Splash filename convention is inconsistent (some use 'splash-iphone-14pro-max.png' without hyphen between '14' and 'pro', others use 'splash-iphone-17-pro-max.png' with hyphen). All 14 files load 200 because index.html references them exactly as named on disk — but the inconsistency makes maintenance error-prone.
